Part of #208. Owner acceptance and closure stay on that issue. The approved explicit Space cards action follows in a separate change.

Undo and Redo keep fixed leading positions while history labels, save notices and connectivity change. Pressed styling preserves their target positions. The loaded editor owns one connection-status notice; the shell supplies it on loading, error and other routes.

Claude Sonnet 5.5 xhigh implemented the UI after GPT architecture review. This candidate integrates the actual merged canvas predecessor #478 and targets main.

## Candidate and verification

Head `5a31678f5a8611ae3a89a1f6aefe797d7106a08e`, tree `c247968a388b1c74e7727ec27d4fe465ebfde0d0`, target main `1cfca9bce3967c9d41950266c83aab636667e0ab`. Final native source is `6b0eae62ea98ae73b22903c9922bba198e219608`; this publication commit changes only QA evidence and delivery metadata. Root verified all 531 new publication blobs and zero product or build-input changes. The 13 history product/test paths remain identical to the first reviewed candidate; inherited canvas product bytes match actual main.

- Final integration passed 224 focused tests across 13 files on its first execution, plus typechecking, scoped lint and formatting. An earlier static evidence wrapper failed to retain the empty lint log; a static-only receipt pass established its exit code, without rerunning Vitest or changing source. Repository-wide formatting passed at publication. [Integration evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5a31678f5a8611ae3a89a1f6aefe797d7106a08e/docs/qa/2026-11-15-history-controls-final-integration/README.md)
- A forced Node 22.23.4 build completed 12 tasks without cache hits. Independent GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh passed all 11 final native groups on their initial attempts, using Edge, the compiled gateway and disposable file SQLite. There were 77 stationary target windows, 21 trusted held presses and 66 exact conditional saves; four real 404 responses established settled error-route ownership. Zero page errors; all owned resources closed. No fixture corrections were used. [Final native evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5a31678f5a8611ae3a89a1f6aefe797d7106a08e/docs/qa/2026-11-15-history-controls-final-native/README.md)
- Before/after bindings matched for 1,683 source paths, 27 embedded modules and 1,227 outputs across 13 distribution trees, with separate emitted-domain mapping. Root fully read the handoff, verified its 455 raw artifacts and the 475-file curated packet, and inspected representative native screenshots.

The original baseline, partial native runs, fixture failures and recovery are retained as historical evidence. The current complete matrix supersedes their coverage gaps without erasing them. Windows Edge automation, injected coarse touch and a DPR-2 reflow proxy do not establish physical touch, actual browser text zoom, screen-reader speech or other engines. Voice, authentication, storage/shutdown, StrictMode and renderer-error ownership retain focused component evidence.

## Remaining gates

All five current-head CI jobs passed on their first attempts: [CI 43682228998](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43682228998) and [routing 43682229004](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43682229004). Gates passed all 22 total Turbo tasks in the coverage invocation for 13 coverage packages, including 2,738 web tests across 218 files. Browser passed 481 tests with one declared live-provider skip and zero retries; Windows passed 14/14; template image and normal routing passed. The high-severity dependency audit threshold passed with eight low and thirteen moderate advisories.

The CI event preceded the base retarget: every job checked out `b08bf0ea5f304bd1bfb83b58dd2588607fb943a8`, whose first parent is the former canvas branch tip. Root independently verified that its complete tree is identical to both the published head and current-main merge `6ae1eff7c27ca49e941b8bb5c4e18f32d34ef7d6`; both base tips also have identical trees. The workflows have no base-dependent execution. These are current-head/tree checks with a pre-retarget event, not a claim that the event targeted main. The final auditor must independently verify this equivalence and actual target context. Normal routing limits passed; the optional strict frame target was not enabled.

The first opposite-family review by GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh returned READY with no introduced blocker; [the full review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/480#issuecomment-6887160473) remains part of the record. Fresh independent Astra max final scan 2 of 3 signed off at this exact head and actual main target, with no introduced blocker or new deferred issue. It independently replayed the native evidence and verified CI context; 60 existing tests and three new external lifecycle checks passed on their first attempts. Root read the complete report and verified all 28 sealed audit artifacts. [Full final audit and root disposition](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/480#issuecomment-6890398559). Engineering merge gates are complete; owner acceptance remains open on #208. No owner instance, store or service was changed.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the merged build and observations on #208:

- Undo/Redo remain easy to find and target while editing, saving and changing connectivity.
- The single connectivity notice and its placement are understandable on desktop and narrow layouts.
- Pressed and disabled controls feel clear without unexpected movement.

Machine-verifiable behavior remains the pipeline's responsibility; this checklist does not replace engineering gates.

**Owner-approved plan, 2026-10-17. Implementation is held.** The owner explicitly authorized publishing the agreed backlog and said not to start implementation. This issue has no pickup gate; release requires a later owner dispatch decision.

Authority and complete owner decision record: #278. Current text supersedes older model proposals and historical scheduling/approval statements; comments remain historical evidence, not a competing current specification.

## Bounded change

Keep Undo/Redo stationary and improve default spacing

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Undo/Redo keep a stable header position during rapid use; newly laid-out/unpositioned graphs are readable without overwriting saved manual geometry.

## Verification

Browser rapid undo/redo at supported desktop widths and default/manual-layout controls.

## Dependencies

- #281 — X-EDITOR
- #279 — implementation dispatch remains held.

## Scope limits

These are independent small UI changes; split into separate delivery patches if they touch different review surfaces. No broad layout redesign.

## Delivery and closure

Approved plan; parked pending explicit dispatch. Proposed implementer: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh; independent reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh; independent QA: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh. QA scope: touched systems, including relevant positive, negative, concurrency, cancellation and restart cases. All tests use supported interfaces; retain existing coverage protections.

**Owner product acceptance required before closure.** PRs use Part of rather than auto-closing this issue until the owner has accepted the running behavior.

No implementation gate labels are applied now. After later dispatch, select the repository gate consistent with owner-review requirements; never combine aidlc-ready and human-in-the-loop.

## Source requirements

#124, #208

## Specific owner feedback

- Higher priority among visual improvements, after serious bugs. Keep node cards minimal. Default layout must not overwrite deliberately saved positions/routes.
- Undo/Redo must retain the same hit-target position during rapid repeated clicks and status/enabled-state changes. Existing shortcuts and history behavior remain intact.

## Evidence provenance (not a new test result)

The observations below describe their original assessed baseline. They are not current solution requirements; the approved scope above controls. Reproduce on the accepted target before relying on them.

### Source #124 — historical evidence

**Backlog: explicitly deferred by the owner on 2026-10-08. Create this issue only; do not plan or implement it yet.** It is outside the current feature PR delivery. No implementation or product gate is active while parked. When unparked: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh implementation; Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh review and QA; touched-systems verification and owner product acceptance.


## Consolidated source reports

- #124: Editor: readable default node spacing when a loop loads.

These reports are closed as duplicate tracking records. Their accepted requirements and owner-review conditions remain in this bolt. This bolt is the sole open delivery record; no implementation or acceptance is claimed by consolidation.
